# Code Review Request

Run a comprehensive code review based on the user's specified scope.

## Available Scopes

If the user specifies a scope after `/codereview`, use that scope:
- **selection** - Review only the currently selected code in the editor
- **file** - Review the current open file
- **folder** - Review all files in a specific folder (ask which folder)
- **changes** - Review uncommitted changes (staged + unstaged via `git diff`)
- **project** - Review the entire project (may take longer)

If no scope is specified, ask the user which scope they want to review.

---

> **Coverage Standard:** AssetMark requires ≥85% line and branch coverage. Any code or tests generated by this prompt must meet this threshold.
